obligations.text: Working assumption: a delete or purge may remove a running action's record, and the running action still finishes normally whether or not its record comes back.
obligations.cases: record deleted while the action runs; save recreates vs not
obligations.basis: new:iteration-70
obligations.gap: history.rs takes the save-recreates outcome as an input (hypothesis H-DELETE-FINALIZE) and does not model the action's status; the crate proves PersistToTwin finds its row only without foreign deletes. Contrast: delete the running load's row before Finalize; the load returns its own status and either the row reappears finalized or stays deleted, decided by %Save on a deleted ID.

obligations.text: Working assumption: errors that mean the requested deletion was not performed are reported.

obligations.gap: Not modeled. Contrast: an SQL failure in a namespace makes delete report an error.
